notes: Both routes meet at شعبة, which the second route writes itself; the names after it belong to both routes.
«قلنا لزيد بن أرقم حدثنا» makes Zayd the one asked who answers, so he is the last link (rule 5). «قلنا» is the unnamed group of askers and is left out.
«- ... -» glosses and the blessing are left out.
